solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Astounded by second pick-up following boom

indicators.note: following says the second and pick-up pieces come after the boom piece

parts.note: a boom is a loud deep noise, like thunder
a pick-up is a small open-backed truck

explanation.surface: Someone is stunned when a second pick-up truck arrives right after a loud bang.
explanation.definitionFit: To be thunderstruck is to be utterly amazed, as if hit by a thunderbolt; a synonym of astounded.

clue.text: Rebukes lots after language

indicators.note: after places the lots piece behind the language piece

parts.note: a tongue is a language, as in mother tongue
lashings is informal British for lots, as in lashings of cream

explanation.surface: Someone receives many reprimands for their bad language.
explanation.walkthrough: LASHINGS is everyday British slang for plenty of something.
explanation.definitionFit: Tongue-lashings are severe scoldings, so they are synonyms of rebukes.

clue.text: A French copper on time — rough as a diamond

parts.note: un is French for a
Cu is the chemical symbol for copper

explanation.surface: A French policeman on duty is a rough diamond of a man.
explanation.definitionFit: An uncut diamond is still rough, not yet shaped or polished by a cutter.

clue.text: Diplomacy means freedom

definitions.meaning: tact and care in what one says or reveals
freedom to decide, as in at your own choice

explanation.definitionFit: Discretion means both tactful prudence and the liberty to choose as one sees fit.

clue.text: One involved in gender-bending ruled

indicators.note: involved in says one piece sits within the other
bending says the letters of gender are twisted into a new order

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone involved in gender-bending held sway over others.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bending' turns GENDER into REGNED, and 'involved in' puts I inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Reigned is the past tense of reign, meaning held power as a monarch, a synonym of ruled.

clue.text: A cougar's victims?

parts.note: a cougar is slang for an older woman who dates much younger men, not only a big cat

explanation.definitionFit: Toy boys are the young male lovers of older women, the prey of a cougar in the slang sense.

clue.text: Threatening good learner in university year

indicators.note: in says the good learner pieces sit inside the university year pieces

parts.note: L is for learner, as on British learner-driver plates

explanation.surface: A good student is in a menacing university year.
explanation.definitionFit: Ugly can describe a situation turning nasty, as an ugly mood or crowd, which is menacing.

clue.text: Learning to recognise ridge

parts.note: to know someone is to recognise them
a ledge is a narrow shelf or ridge of rock

explanation.surface: A student learns to identify a mountain ridge.
explanation.definitionFit: Knowledge is what one gains through study, which is what learning means as a noun.

clue.text: Poor toddler who ate lizard's tail is unconscious

indicators.note: poor suggests the words are in a bad state, so the letters are rearranged
tail picks the last letter of the word lizard

explanation.surface: A poor toddler who swallowed a lizard's tail has passed out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Poor' scrambles TODDLER WHO ATE into DEADTOTHEWORL; 'tail' adds D, the end of lizard.
explanation.definitionFit: Dead to the world is an idiom for being deeply asleep or out cold, so unconscious.

clue.text: Fundamental precursor to invention

parts.note: alludes to the proverb that calls this thing the mother of invention

explanation.definitionFit: The proverb says need gives birth to invention, so a basic requirement is its forerunner.

clue.text: Escaped ducks adopted by London college

indicators.note: adopted by says the ducks are taken inside the college

parts.note: LSE is the London School of Economics
a duck is a score of nothing in cricket, so two ducks look like OO

explanation.surface: Ducks that got away have been taken in by a London college.
explanation.definitionFit: An animal on the loose has broken free, so loose is a synonym of escaped.

clue.text: Complete some without territorials

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Some troops are fully lacking territorial soldiers.
explanation.definitionFit: Utter means absolute or total, as in utter nonsense, so it is a synonym of complete.

clue.text: Lacking authorisation for recess?

parts.note: no means lacking, as in no money
an OK is an approval or authorisation

explanation.surface: A hiding place you go into without permission.
explanation.definitionFit: A nook is a small sheltered corner, a synonym of recess.

clue.text: Scottish family forgets name for daughter getting dressed

indicators.note: forgets says one letter is dropped from the family word
for says another letter takes the dropped one's place

parts.note: a clan is a Scottish family group

explanation.surface: A Scottish family forgets a name when a daughter gets dressed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'forgets name for daughter' swaps the N of CLAN for D.
explanation.definitionFit: Clad is an old past participle of clothe, meaning wearing clothes, so dressed.

clue.text: Cupid's rival god

definitions.note: read as Cupid is, the 's standing for is

parts.note: a match is an equal or rival, as in more than a match for
the Maker is God the creator

explanation.surface: Cupid has a competitor among the gods.
explanation.walkthrough: Cupid's reads as 'Cupid is', the definition with a joining verb.
explanation.definitionFit: Cupid brings lovers together, which is the work of someone who arranges romantic pairings.

clue.text: Found date upset by unprotected sheep

indicators.note: unprotected says the word for sheep loses its outer covering, its first and last letters

parts.note: a flock is a group of sheep

indicators.note: upset says the letters of date are knocked into a new order

explanation.surface: A date is disrupted by sheep that have no shelter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unprotected' strips FLOCK to LOC; 'upset' turns DATE into ATED.
explanation.definitionFit: Found in the sense of situated, as a house is found by the river, is a synonym of located.

clue.text: Cold and rather stupid editor took out a lease

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps

indicators.note: stupid says the letters of rather are muddled

explanation.surface: A cold and somewhat dim editor rented a property.
explanation.definitionFit: To charter is to hire a ship, plane or vehicle under contract, so chartered means rented it.

clue.text: The blighter is average, covering a case of need

indicators.note: covering says the average piece wraps round the others

parts.note: so-so means average, middling

indicators.note: case of means the outside letters of the word need

explanation.surface: The scoundrel is mediocre, enclosing a needy case.
explanation.walkthrough: So-so is informal for middling; 'covering' wraps it round A plus the edges that 'case of' takes from need.
explanation.definitionFit: So-and-so is a euphemism for an unpleasant person, much like the mild insult blighter.

clue.text: Fine ducks on view, say, with day's main course

indicators.note: on, in an across clue, puts the fine ducks piece after the view piece
say signals a word that sounds like the view piece

parts.note: to view is to see
F is the abbreviation for fine, as on pencils
a duck is a nil score in cricket, so ducks look like OO
D is the abbreviation for day

explanation.surface: A diner looks at ducks while taking the day's main dish.
explanation.definitionFit: Seafood is fish and shellfish eaten as a meal, which is one choice of main course.

clue.text: Where to put dead stub out at home?

indicators.note: out says the letters of stub are put out of order

parts.note: in means at home, as in staying in

explanation.surface: Where should a cigarette stub be put out at home?
explanation.definitionFit: A dustbin is the British name for a household rubbish bin, the place to throw things away.

clue.text: Play, but be absorbed by match being fixed

indicators.note: absorbed by says one piece is soaked up inside the other
being fixed says the match letters are rigged into a new order

explanation.surface: A sports match is rigged, and someone must take it in.
explanation.walkthrough: A fixed match in the surface is a rigged game; here 'being fixed' reorders its letters to MACTH, and 'absorbed by' takes be inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Macbeth is a tragedy by Shakespeare, an example of a play.

clue.text: Harbour fee from North African on time

parts.note: a Moor is a Muslim of north-west Africa
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: A harbour charge is taken from a North African sailor on time.
explanation.definitionFit: Moorage is the charge paid for tying a boat up at a berth, a harbour fee.

clue.text: A bit of an idiot, actually!

indicators.note: of says the answer is a part taken from the words that follow

explanation.surface: Someone is just a little bit foolish, honestly.
explanation.definitionFit: An iota is a tiny amount, from the smallest Greek letter, so it is a synonym of a bit.

clue.text: Look after contents of lost city

indicators.note: after puts the look piece behind the contents piece
contents of means the letters inside the word lost, without its ends

parts.note: lo is an old word for look, as in lo and behold

explanation.surface: Someone is told to keep an eye on whatever is in a lost bag.
explanation.definitionFit: Oslo is the capital city of Norway.

clue.text: Parrot beginning to make a crow cry

indicators.note: beginning to picks the first letter of the word make

parts.note: caw is the harsh call of a crow

explanation.surface: A parrot starts making a crow call.
explanation.definitionFit: A macaw is a large brightly coloured tropical American parrot, an example of the bird.

clue.text: Do church and have dinner

parts.note: to have dinner is to eat

explanation.surface: Someone goes to church and then sits down to dinner.
explanation.definitionFit: To do someone is slang for swindling them, so it is a synonym of cheat.

clue.text: Elegant hotel in island group west of Cuba

indicators.note: west of, in a down clue, puts the island group piece before the Cuba piece
in says the hotel piece sits inside the island group piece

parts.note: CI stands for the Channel Islands
H is hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet
C is the international vehicle code for Cuba

explanation.surface: A stylish hotel stands on an island chain to the west of Cuba.
explanation.definitionFit: Chic means stylish and fashionable, a synonym of elegant.

clue.text: Waistline that's roughly right

indicators.note: roughly says the letters of right are handled roughly into a new order

explanation.surface: A waist measurement that is approximately correct.
explanation.definitionFit: Girth is the measurement round the middle of something, so a person's waistline.

clue.text: Jet has to carry animal

parts.note: jet is a deep glossy black
to bear is to carry

explanation.surface: An aircraft has to transport an animal.
explanation.definitionFit: A black bear is a species of North American or Asian bear, an example of an animal.

clue.text: Removed religious restriction — and secret code changes

indicators.note: changes says the letters of the words before it are rearranged

explanation.surface: A secret code is altered once a religious ban has been lifted.
explanation.definitionFit: To deconsecrate is to declare a church no longer sacred, lifting its religious status.
